preregistered.statement: The same membrane verification pipeline runs on Linux.
preregistered.prediction: CPU, build, and Vulkan comparison pass with unchanged fixtures and numerical tolerances.
preregistered.falsifier: Any failed comparison, invalid output, build failure, or unavailable execution stage prevents a Linux PASS.

install.command: sudo -n apt-get update && sudo -n apt-get install -y cmake libvulkan-dev glslc python3-venv && python3 -m venv .venv-linux && .venv-linux/bin/python -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check --no-input numpy
